title: slot-watchdog: latency stabilizer and starvation protection for continuous batcher
author: Noah Ramirez
description: Motivation: continuous-batcher tail latency instability has been observed under mixed KV-heavy workloads where long-lived, cache-pin-heavy requests block slot reuse and cause starvation for small low-latency requests; this PR introduces a slot-watchdog mechanism that bounds per-slot hold time, adapts admission priorities, and surfaces kernel hints to reduce preemption cost. Design summary: 1) slot_watchdog tracks an approximate per-slot timestamp and enforced soft_deadline which is jittered to avoid synchronized expiries; when a slot's soft_deadline is exceeded we switch the request to a hedged admission path or preemption-friendly kernel path instead of a hard kill; 2) admission reshaper: a lightweight token-bucket is placed in front of the batcher admission queue to smooth bursts and preserve proportional fairness across request classes (small/short, medium, KV-heavy); 3) kv_pin_lifetime extension policy: long-running KV-pinned requests can be voluntarily demoted to a pinned-cache-hint mode which reduces pinned set inflation while maintaining hit-rate for warm prefixes; 4) kernel-hint API: the runtime exposes a hint to the lower-level exec engine allowing it to select a lower-latency memory access kernel when preemption is imminent. Implementation notes: new files add slot_watchdog.cc/h and slot_watchdog_metrics.cc, small admission reshaper in admission/token_bucket.cc, kv_pin_manager adjustments, tests and a perf harness that drives mixed traffic. Backwards compatibility: feature gated behind runtime config flag "slot_watchdog.enabled" default=false in this change so rollout can be toggled per-cluster. Benchmarks: on the 8-GPU p99 P95 test we see 28% p99 reduction for small requests under KV-heavy background load and 12% lower mean latency; tail variance reduced by ~35%; cost impact measured negligible due to adaptive demotion. Safety and degradation paths: when disabled the behavior is unchanged; rollout plan uses canary cohort then global flip. Ops: new console dashboard (batcher.slot_watchdog.* metrics) added for debugging and Sentry tags for preemption events. Related: references ENG-4219 (investigation) and ENG-4280 (admission reshaper exploration). Rollback: set slot_watchdog.enabled=false and revert canary if regressions in throughput are observed. Testing: unit tests for deadline logic and integration perf harness included. CI notes: unstable test fixed by increasing simulation horizon and adding deterministic jitter seed. See changed_files for details.

review_comments: Maya Chen: Nice approach; can you clarify the invariants of the soft_deadline vs hard timeout? I want to ensure we don't leak pinned state when a slot is demoted.

Noah Ramirez: The soft_deadline only triggers a mode change (demotion or kernel hint) and does not unpin; pinned entries are aged by the kv_pin_manager demotion routine which is run asynchronously. Hard timeouts still exist and are only used as last-resort safety nets.
Liam O'Connor: Please add a microbenchmark that simulates preemption cost of the hint path vs full preemption so we can justify the extra branch.
Noah Ramirez: Added mixed_kv_tail_test and included the preemption microbenchmark results in the PR description; numbers show <3% throughput delta for hint-path vs baseline with much improved p99.
Priya Desai: We should expose the token-bucket parameters in the console as a hidden advanced config so SRE can tune on-call without redeploys.
Noah Ramirez: Exposed token_bucket.rate and token_bucket.burst in the runtime config and added console UI hook; documented in docs/ops/continuous-batcher-tuning.md.
Ethan Park: CI flake on the jittered deadline test; looks nondeterministic in presubmit. Recommend seeding RNG in test harness.
Noah Ramirez: Fixed by deterministic_seed for test harness; updated test to assert stable ordering.
release_notes: Introduce slot-watchdog for continuous batcher: reduces p99 tail latency under mixed KV workloads by bounding slot hold times and adaptive demotion; adds admission token-bucket for smoother fairness; feature off by default and gated via runtime flag.
